context: Judge final artifacts, including response.json, against supplied fixtures. Do not infer operation order from the final state or award credit for promises. Paths are relative to workspace/ unless explicitly prefixed supplied/.

checklist.name: payload-and-evidence-preservation
checklist.description: The existing current and older calendar payloads are byte-identical to their fixtures. The processed inbox item is removed only after verifying the existing filed payload is identical. No automatic inbox archive duplicate is created. Any preexisting historical inbox archive record remains byte-identical at its existing path. No YAML is inserted into native records; 0-inbox/planning.ics no longer remains an unprocessed working capture.

checklist.name: filing-and-deduplication-boundary
checklist.description: The existing current record is reused, with no extra working invitation or duplicate current link. No new inbox archive copy is created; preserve any already-existing historical copy untouched. Reuse the identical filed record; do not suffix or rename verified identical existing records. The Current target and older historical navigation remain correct.

checklist.name: navigation-and-completion
checklist.description: All calendar index links resolve to the intended versions and existing index frontmatter is preserved. The response accurately reports retained/reused records and final locations; it does not request confirmation of routine historical labels or already-authorized filing when no blocker remains.
